capabilities: Render a future-data JSON code block as a full-width interactive goal table
Plan goals across a year-by-year timeline with Future/Now/Gap metric columns
Edit rows inline with bidirectional sync between table and markdown file
Filter rows by status, scope, commitment, search text, and linked-note state
Bind goals to Obsidian notes and drag-and-drop rows between parents
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation requires building from source with npm and copying files into the vault; no community plugin store install is described.
motivation: The author wanted a place where wishes can be captured quickly but kept inside a larger map of life categories, so no single area like work or spending crowds out health and family.
problem: Life-planning tools are either locked inside proprietary apps or scattered across unstructured markdown files, and they treat decade-long dreams and weekend chores as the same kind of task.
summary: Hierarchical life-goal planning table rendered from a JSON code block, with a year-by-year timeline, scope and commitment levels, and inline editing.
